object.attr: analysis: CF-V56. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V6), to confirm: a record in the object's own file survives any git client, unlike the merge message. The format change goes through STORE (handed over). It unblocks MELLON-VER-SRS-76 and MELLON-VER-SRS-226.
object.description: When Mellon renumbers an object in a merge, Mellon shall record in the renumbered object's file the object's earlier object ID and the merge's parent commits.
